findings.evidence: `rg -n "cokernel|classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange|quotientKerEquivRange"` finds line 42 claiming cokernel, while lines 119-122 define `S.ClassGroup ⧸ picZero w h ≃+ (weightedDegreeClass w h).range` via `QuotientAddGroup.quotientKerEquivRange`.
findings.fix: Replace “cokernel” with “image”/“first-isomorphism quotient”, or add a separate cokernel theorem with target `ℤ ⧸ (weightedDegreeClass w h).range` if that is intended.
findings.issue: The docstring says this computes “the cokernel of the degree map”, but the new API proves `S.ClassGroup ⧸ picZero w h ≃+ (weightedDegreeClass w h).range`, i.e. quotient by the kernel is the image; the cokernel of `weightedDegreeClass w h : Cl(X) → ℤ` would be `ℤ ⧸ (weightedDegreeClass w h).range`.

summary: The formal statements about the image and the first-isomorphism quotient are mathematically coherent, but the module documentation falsely claims to compute a cokernel.
